time_source: UTC candle OPEN timestamps; decision at end of completed 15m candle
registration_rule: must be committed before first eligible post-cutoff decision; never edit evaluation settings after observing outcomes
evaluation_note: Existing 2022-07/2026 Bybit historical archive is already inspected and cannot count as unseen forward market evidence
market: Bybit research-only 15m completed OHLCV; no broker orders or account balance use

source_eligibility.source_validation_scope: V14/V15 explicit caller upstream guarantee. V17 does not independently recompute real source pivot evidence; separate future source-binder required.

hypothetical_execution.structural_stop: last confirmed post-five-swing correction low, not proxy ATR
hypothetical_execution.pending_outcome: no P/L until stop, target or bar64 time exit
hypothetical_execution.exit_fees_and_slippage: each leg fixed by profile; cash backed; no leverage

integrity_constraints: Reject bar timestamps lacking timezone/alignment or nonexistent/partial future OHLC
Only contiguous fully completed bars known at observation timestamp
Reject omitted, duplicated or shifted bars; hash canonical future bar payload
Reject historical decisions prior to forward cutoff and decisions at/after end
Never fit thresholds, wave criteria or profiles on already inspected folds
Unknown intrabar sequence uses adverse stop-first priority; full-bar MAE/MFE not claimed as executable experience
No external action to Bybit, no Demo promotion and no LIVE use
acceptance_gates: Local deterministic adversarial feature/exit unit tests pass
Independent source hash and V15/V14 event binder for genuinely future observations
Independent trade-ledger P/L arithmetic reconciliation including next-open gap, fees, stop-first
Enough uncontaminated future closed candle outcomes to estimate uncertainty: no minimum trade-count hard gate, but low counts cannot prove edge
Separate user-authorized Demo-only promotion review; NEVER live
caveat: This is an evaluation protocol, NOT evidence that Elliott is profitable or recursive wave labels are complete. V17 code is not wired to Strategy Finder/Paper/runner.
